items.title: Phasmophobia's Crimson Eye Is Back, and VR Players Get It on a Rebuilt Body for the First Time
items.summary: Crimson Eye runs to November 1, and it is the first one since Kinetic replaced Phasmophobia's VR character rig. The three VR bugs still open in August were…
items.content:
Red light does something to a room you already know. I have walked the ground floor of 6 Tanglewood Drive enough times to find the fuse box with my eyes shut, and when the Blood Moon comes up over it I still stop in the doorway like a guest.

Phasmophobia 's Crimson Eye event started Thursday and runs through November 1. Nina Castillo put it on our Halloween calendar on Friday with all eight maps and the reward list, so I am not going to recite them. I want to talk about the body you are wearing when you walk in. This is the first Crimson Eye since Kinetic Games threw out the game's VR character rig and built a new one.

The swap landed on August 25 in v0.19, and Nina took it apart that week : a new skeleton, arms matched to your own reach, ten VR fixes of which five were doors. She also listed three VR bugs Kinetic still had marked as open. Head gear knocked off when someone shut a door on you. Blank profile pictures in the lobby. A ragdoll that folded up wrong if you died with Immersive Animations switched on.

All three are in the fixed column of the September 10 patch . Sixteen days. That same patch added a VR Belt Offset setting, which slides your equipment belt higher or lower on your body, and it moved where your hand sits on the tier one D.O.T.S. projector and on every tier of flashlight, photo camera and video camera, with a note from Kinetic that "more equipment will be improved with future updates."

If you have only played this on a monitor, a belt height slider sounds like nothing. In a headset it is the difference between glancing down for the thermometer and patting your own hip like you lost your keys.

Kinetic's event post does not say much about what the Blood Moon changes. You hunt down totems, you finish investigations and optional objectives for points, and you do it, quoting the post, "all while under the threat of Blood Moon weather, increasing the challenge you'll face from ghosts." That is the entire description. Harder ghosts, redder houses.

So why bother strapping a screen to your face for it? Because Phasmophobia listens to your microphone, and the store page is not shy about it: "The Ghosts are listening!" On a monitor you are a person at a desk asking a spirit box how old it is. In a headset you are standing in that hallway with the box in your actual hand, asking with your actual mouth, and the part of your brain that knows better takes a second to show up. I have played a lot of VR horror. Very little of it gets me with something as cheap as my own voice.

Nell's Diner is in the rotation this year, along with the reworked versions of 6 Tanglewood Drive and 13 Willow Street, and Kinetic makes a point of saying you will get to see how those look "dressed in red." Even if you did this last October, part of the list is new under this light.

October 15 through 22. Kinetic doubles XP and rewards on every completed investigation that week. The Twitch drop for the Crimson Eye tee (two hours of watching any Phasmophobia stream) closes at 11:59 PM BST on the 15th, so the two overlap on the 15th and no longer. The final week, October 26 to November 1, brings back Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association. Kinetic says the community raised over $100,000 last year and that this year's rewards will be open to every player, details to follow.

One more date sits behind all of it. The move to Unity 6 was meant for October and slipped to November , which makes this the last event on the engine the game runs on today, assuming November holds. I would not sit out a Halloween waiting for it. Engine migrations break things first and fix them second, and I say that as someone who runs a small studio and has watched an engine upgrade eat a month.

There is no VR edition to buy. Phasmophobia is one game, $19.99 on Steam as of today, tagged VR Supported, and it runs through SteamVR with tracked controllers. On console it is $19.99 on PS5 , where PS VR2 is optional and the listing says the Sense controllers are required if you use it. There is no native Quest version. A Quest can still play the Steam copy by streaming it from a gaming PC with Valve's free Steam Link app, whose listing asks for a Quest 2, 3 or Pro, a 5GHz router, and a PC already running Steam and SteamVR.

Four people to a lobby, and they do not all need headsets. Flat and VR players share rooms (the September notes include a fix for a PC player and a VR player grabbing the same door), which solves the problem I always have with co-op VR: I own the headset, and my friends own opinions about headsets.

On a Steam Frame , Valve's rating is still Unsupported, from the same July 22 test I wrote about on October 1 . The app record had not moved as of this morning. And if something in VR is broken, Kinetic wants the report through its Help Centre , not the Steam forums.

My own Frame reservation still has no purchase email attached to it, so it will be the Quest 3 and a PC for me. Thursday night, lights off, Nell's Diner. I already know I am going to say the ghost's name too quietly to count.

items.title: Phasmophobia has sold 30 million copies, and its Halloween Crimson Eye event is live now
items.summary: Phasmophobia has passed 30 million sales since its Early Access launch, and its Halloween Crimson Eye event is now live until 1st November.
items.content:
Image credit: Adobe Stock / fotokitas News by Vikki Blake Contributor Published on Oct. 11, 2026, 12:06 p.m. 2 comments Follow Phasmophobia Prioritise us on Google Phasmophobia has sold more than 30 million copies across PC and console since it launched in Early Access in 2020.

Developer Kinetic Games shared the milestone alongside confirming the return of Crimson Eye, its annual Halloween event, which is now live and runs until 1st November.

Crimson Eye brings blood moon weather to a rotating set of maps each day, which makes ghosts faster and drains your sanity more quickly, but pays out more in return. The event maps are Tanglewood Drive, Camp Woodwind, Grafton Farmhouse, Bleasdale Farmhouse, Point Hope (standard only), Edgefield Road, Nell's Diner, and Willow Street.

Community goals unlock the Beholder ID Card and Badge, and the Blood Moon Trophy, while personal goals unlock the Blood Moon Charm, a seasonal t-shirt, and upgrades to the Crimson Eye trophy.

If that's not quite enough for you, watch two hours' worth of Phasmophobia streams on Twitch between 8th and 15th October and you'll get a Crimson Eye t-shirt cosmetic. You can also earn double XP and rewards from 15th to 22nd October.

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts is also back for the final week of the event, from 26th October to 1st November, in support of the American Heart Association. The Phasmophobia community raised more than $100,000 for the charity last year.

"So much has changed since I started making Phasmophobia on my own at my parents' house," said Kinetic Games CEO and Phasmophobia game director Daniel Knight.

"My initial goal was to sell 1000 units in the first year, so it's hard to believe we're celebrating 30 million. I'm so grateful to everyone who has played, and to the team who have worked alongside me on it. There is plenty more to come as we head towards 1.0."

That 1.0 release is slated for the second half of 2027, and Kinetic Games will start sharing sneak peeks of its development next year, including major overhauls to ghost design and gameplay.

The studio also launched a publishing arm, Kinetic Publishing , earlier this year. Its first game, the starship job simulator Contact Protocol, is due out in Spring 2027.

Phasmophobia is available in Early Access on Steam, PS5, PS VR2, and Xbox Series X/S. It's also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 , although we still don't quite know when.

Earlier this year, Kinetic Games confirmed Phasmophobia's 1.0 launch had slipped from this year into 2027 , as the studio said it was prioritising quality over speed following a rocky reception to its Player Character Update. Kinetic Games ended up apologising to players for issues with its long-awaited 'Player Character Update' , admitting it "missed the mark" and "didn't deliver on our promises to you".

In numerous patches and hotfixes released since to address the many issues spawned by the latest update, the studio explained how it had been working through player feedback to provide "a much better experience for everyone playing Phasmophobia". More recently, Kinetic released Phasmophobia's second Quality of Life update , adding a raft of new Restricted maps, streamlined Evidence collection, VR fixes, and considerably more ways to die.

"We've read feedback from across the entire community. The frustration and disappointment has been clear," the team admitted.

items.title: “Crimson Eye” Event Returns to ‘Phasmophobia’, Now Stands at 30 Million Sold
PHASMOPHOBIA LAUNCHES SEASONAL CRIMSON EYE EVENT AS GAME HITS 30 MILLION SALES
items.summary: It’s all treats and no tricks as the genre-defining co-op horror title hits a major milestone alongside the return of its annual Halloween eventSOUTHAMPTON,...
items.content:
Press release — 8 October 2026 12:27 Share Share this story Copy link Link copied! Download

It’s all treats and no tricks as the genre-defining co-op horror title hits a major milestone alongside the return of its annual Halloween event

SOUTHAMPTON, UK – October 8th, 2026 – Today, Kinetic Games announces that Phasmophobia has surpassed 30 million sales since its Early Access release across PC and console as its annual in-game Halloween event, Crimson Eye, launches for another year of terrifying hunts and seasonal rewards.

Since launching into Early Access in 2020, Phasmophobia has grown from a solo project into a global horror phenomenon, with Kinetic Games continuing to expand and evolve the game with new content and seasonal events. Until November 1st, Crimson Eye brings ghost hunters spectral rewards, spooktacular frights and bone-chilling challenges, with rotating event maps featuring blood moon weather for even more terrifying hunts. Ghosts have increased speed and sanity drains quicker, but brave players can earn higher rewards in return.

The fan-favourite fright has now been running for three years, with the blood moon first appearing in Phasmophobia in 2024. Crimson Eye returns this year as the team celebrates another major milestone: 30 million sales worldwide.

Starting as a solo project, Phasmophobia has grown into a global co-op horror phenomenon across PC and console. Throughout the game’s journey in Early Access, the Kinetic Games team has worked to expand haunted locations, introduce new ghost types and improve player character models, all shaped closely by community feedback.

This year alone, two major Quality of Life updates brought vast improvements to player characters, customisation and evidence collection, while introducing further Restricted maps for fast-paced ghost-hunting.

“So much has changed since I started making Phasmophobia on my own at my parents' house,” commented Daniel Knight, CEO of Kinetic Games and Game Director for Phasmophobia. “My initial goal was to sell 1000 units in the first year, so it’s hard to believe we’re celebrating 30 million. I’m so grateful to everyone who has played, and to the team who have worked alongside me on it. There is plenty more to come as we head towards 1.0.”

Phasmophobia’s success has also enabled Kinetic Games to expand its ambitions beyond the game itself, with the studio launching Kinetic Publishing earlier this year to champion independent development teams. Drawing on Daniel Knight’s journey from solo developer to global success, the publishing division gives indie devs the support and resources to make incredible games without compromising their creative vision. The first Kinetic Publishing Showcase in August revealed its first slate of titles, with its first game, starship job simulator Contact Protocol , launching in Spring 2027.

Looking ahead, the Kinetic Games team is gearing up for Phasmophobia’s highly anticipated 1.0 release, slated for the second half of 2027. Beginning next year, the studio will share spooky sneak peeks into the update’s development, including major overhauls to ghost design and overall gameplay.

The Crimson Eye event is available now in Phasmophobia, including:

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association

Phasmophobia is available in Early Access on Steam , PS5 , PS VR2 , and Xbox Series X|S , priced at $19.99/£16.75/€19.50.

Assets for this announcement can be found here . For more information on the Crimson Eye event, please see the blog post here .

items.summary: Phasmophobia’s Crimson Eye event brings tougher ghosts, Halloween cosmetics, double XP, and a charity fundraiser through November 1.
items.content:
Phasmophobia’s Crimson Eye event brings tougher ghosts, Halloween cosmetics, double XP, and a charity fundraiser through November 1.

X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .discount{ display:none; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .discount .discount-tag{ line-height: 24px !important; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button.most-popular .join-now-button:hover { background: #000 !important; color: #fff !important; outline: 1px solid #fff !important; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .join-now-button:hover { background: 0 0; outline: 1px solid rgba(12, 12, 12, 1); color: rgba(12, 12, 12, 1); } @media (max-width: 1220px){ .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .join-now-button { width: 100% !important; position: unset !important; } } With spooky season well underway, it’s no surprise that the multiplayer horror game Phasmophobia has a new event available. Here is a breakdown of the recent update and everything players can earn while playing during the event.

Phasmophobia is a spooky, thrilling co-op game that places up to four players in one of 17 distinct maps, from an empty house on 6 Tanglewood Drive to an abandoned prison and a rambling farmhouse. All of these places share one crucial element: they are incredibly, undoubtedly haunted. Whether it’s the banshee, the moroi, the revenant, or any of the 30 entities in the game, players have to figure out who, or what, is on their tail, gather enough evidence to name the entity, and escape.

Launched on October 8th, Phasmophobia is now in the middle of its Crimson Eye event, an annual party that adds the scarlet Blood Moon to the sky. Certain maps, including 6 Tanglewood Drive, the Bleasedale Farmhouse, and Nell’s Diner, are bathed in a ruby glow that noticeably affects ghostly presences and players alike.

Under the gaze of the Crimson Eye, entities become more aggressive, moving faster and more often while draining the player’s sanity more quickly. But the increased challenge comes with plenty of rewards. Kinetic Games, the studio behind Phasmophobia , is offering several rewards during the event, including a special offer for Twitch streamers.

‘Phasmophobia’s’ Blood Moon Returns With Rewards for Ghost Hunters and Twitch Streamers During the first week of the event, from October 8 to October 15, Phasmophobia players who stream on Twitch will receive an in-game cosmetic, the Crimson Eye T-shirt, if they stream for a total of two hours.

Next, from October 15 to October 22, players will earn double reward points for completing an investigation, plus Double XP. During the Crimson Eye event, reward points earn players the Crimson Eye t-shirt, the Blood Moon charm to attach to gear, and the Crimson Eye trophy, which players can display in their lobby. As a community, players can pool reward points to earn custom backgrounds and cosmetics.

Ghost hunters can even give back during this spooky event. From October 26 to November 1, Phasmophobia will once again partner with the American Heart Association for Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts. During this part of the event, the community can come together to raise money for the AHA, earning a limited-edition AHA badge and the satisfaction of supporting an important cause. Last year, the community raised over $100,000 for the charity!

All told, the Crimson Eye event will run from October 8 to November 1. Phasmophobia is available on PC (Steam), PlayStation, and Xbox.

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We have an update for you.

Today’s small update is in preparation for Crimson Eye, launching 8th October 2026, with the focus on getting the game ready for the start of the event. Our next major update, our move to Unity 6 is scheduled for November and will feature a host of bug fixes and improvements, all of which we’ll detail in an upcoming Development Preview.

New

 

  • Crimson Eye - The Crimson Eye is upon us, Ghost Hunters. Once more, various locations across Phasmophobia will be bathed in the red glow of the Blood Moon, offering any willing Ghost Hunter rewards in return for completing investigations, optional objectives and more. For more information on this year’s iteration of the event, please read our latest blogpost. 

    [/*]

  • Seasonal Event toggle - As a new feature for Crimson Eye and future seasonal events, we have implemented a toggle that allows players to turn on/off the event maps for their session. 

    [/*]

 

Fixes

  • Fixed an issue that caused the white light upon being revived to flash rather than slowly fade in and out.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where an Easter Egg reward may not unlock, despite a 0x multiplier being active and the reward pop up being displayed.

    [/*]

Known Issues

  • The lampposts outside of 6 Tanglewood Drive may glow when viewed by the player.

    [/*]

  • The Fusebox location will not be hidden on the Truck map when playing on a custom difficulty.

items.content:
Once more, Ghost Hunters, we pay homage to the Blood Moon. Our dear Crimson Eye.

Today, we’re excited to reveal that this year’s Crimson Eye event will begin on October 8th, 2026, and run until November 1st, 2026. An update containing the event will be deployed on October 6th.

As with previous years’ events, the Crimson Eye will cast its presence across several locations in Phasmophobia. Playing on these locations will grant each player event points, working towards unlocking the Community and Personal rewards, details of which are below.

The following list of locations will be featured throughout the event:

  • 6 Tanglewood Drive

    [/*]

  • 42 Edgefield Road

    [/*]

  • Grafton Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • 13 Willow Street

    [/*]

  • Bleasdale Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • Point Hope (Standard only, Point Hope Restricted will not be included)

    [/*]

  • Camp Woodwind

    [/*]

  • Nell’s Diner

    [/*]

For those of you who have taken part in previous Crimson Eye events, you’ll know what to expect, but you’ll also get to see how Nell’s Diner and the reworked 6 Tanglewood Drive & 13 Willow Street look dressed in red. For newer Ghost Hunters, you’ll be tasked with hunting down Blood Moon totems and completing investigations and optional objectives to earn points, all while under the threat of Blood Moon weather, increasing the challenge you’ll face from ghosts.

Players will have several different unlockable rewards during the event: a seasonal event tee, the Beholder ID Card & Badge set and the Blood Moon charm.

Alongside these will be the upgradeable trophy. If you have previously unlocked this, you’ll continue to earn points and upgrades to your existing Trophy, rather than a new one.

During the event, we have a few different plans in place, so please do read on to learn what’s in store throughout October.

Twitch Drop

During the first week of Crimson Eye, a Twitch Drop campaign will be running for all Phasmophobia streamers. After watching a total of two hours of Phasmophobia streams, you’ll earn the Crimson Eye tee. The campaign will be live from the moment the event begins until 11:59 PM BST on October 15th, 2026.

Double XP & Rewards

As is becoming tradition with Phasmophobia’s seasonal events, we’ll be running a Double XP & Rewards event during Crimson Eye. This will be taking place between October 15th–22nd, with all rewards from completed investigations being doubled during this period. Mark your calendars, Ghost Hunters!

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association

Finally, during the final week of Crimson Eye (October 26th–November 1st), we’ll be bringing back Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with our friends over at the American Heart Association! Last year, the Phasmophobia community raised over $100,000, which was an incredible achievement and went a long way towards helping the AHA team with their important work.

This year, we’re planning to go bigger and better; this event, and its rewards, will be accessible to all Phasmophobia creators & players when it goes live. While we’ll share details nearer the time, we just wanted to get the dates in your calendars!

We look forward to celebrating our favourite season with you once again, Ghost Hunters.

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We’ve got an update for you.

Today, we have released an update for Phasmophobia to address two issues that have been raised by the community since the release of our last update.

Fixes

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We’ve got an update for you.

Today, we have released an update for Phasmophobia to address several issues that were raised following our latest Quality of Life update. Thank you to everyone who has helped with information and feedback to help us identify and fix these bugs.

Our next update following this will be our transition to Unity 6. This will be releasing in November, which is just a little shift from our original aim of October. We’ll be talking in more detail about this update as well as our cosmetics update in an upcoming Development Preview. Rest assured, our Crimson Eye event is still scheduled for October. More on that at a later date too.

Full patch notes for today’s release can be found below:

New

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Today we have released Phasmophobia v0.19.0.0, our latest update that brings with it the second part of our Quality of Life update. Full patch notes can be found below, and in-depth details on what’s new can be found in this blog.

New

  • Added new Restricted variants of the below maps.

    [/*]

  • Prison

    • Brownstone High School

      [/*]

    • Point Hope

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Video Cameras, Photo Cameras and Sound Recorders will now indicate Duplicate evidence.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display faded text rather than the usual bold white text.

      [/*]

    • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

      [/*]

    • Tier 2 & 3 Sound Recorders will display faded sound waves.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The Journal will now display other player selections of Evidence and Ghost Type.

    [/*]

  • The Keys section in the Journal has been replaced with Items We’ve Found, this new section will show keys, the bone and seasonal event collectables.

    [/*]

  • Added the ability to select the Ghost Type in a Custom Difficulty which will set the multiplier to 0.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Legacy Badge section to the Customisation shop to allow you to edit your badge at any time.

    [/*]

  • Players without a Legacy Badge will not see this option.

    [/*]

  • Added a ‘Hold Use’ sticky note on the Training whiteboards.

    [/*]

  • Dead players and dead player bodies will now look dead.

    [/*]

  • Added unique video evidence text for shower and fuse box interactions.

    [/*]

  • Added an icon to show whether a ghost name is male or female.

    [/*]

  • The Evidence page will now highlight the required Ghost evidence when the player selects a Ghost type.

    [/*]

Changes

  • Photo and Video Camera screens will now disable when clipping through a wall

    [/*]

  • When speaking, the speaker icon on ID cards will now function for all players, including local player

    [/*]

  • Improvements have been made to the VR character rig, allowing for more accurate and responsive movement.

    [/*]

  • Players can now interact with a Spirit Box when not grabbed using Text Voice Recognition Mode

    [/*]

  • Custom Difficulties with a 0 multiplier will no longer contribute towards any progress, such as achievements and leaflets.

    [/*]

  • Pressing use while holding a lit T1 firelight will now use another, without having to wait for the animation to finish.

    [/*]

  • When a player dies, their voice chat will now be cut out as soon as they die in the animation, rather than at the end.

    [/*]

  • The Truck has been moved closer to the main entrance on Brownstone High School and Prison

    [/*]

General Fixes

  • Improvements made to network stability to reduce disconnects.

    [/*]

    [/*]

    [/*]

    [/*]

    [/*]

Ghost Fixes

Environment Fixes

    [/*]

    [/*]

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Thank you to everyone for the warm reception to our first Quality of Life update last month, and we’re glad to see many of you enjoying Phasmophobia once more.

Today as promised, we’re sharing details on the upcoming second Quality of Life update for Phasmophobia. We’ll be releasing this update across all platforms on 25th August, 2026. Exact release times are still to be confirmed, so keep an eye on our channels for official confirmation of when the update is live. 

Let’s break down a couple of the features we’re excited about before sharing the full list: 

New Restricted Options

For a long while, we have seen folks requesting smaller versions of our larger maps in the vein of Sunny Meadows Restricted. With this update we’re excited to introduce Restricted versions for Prison, Brownstone High School and Point Hope.

As with Sunny Meadows, these map variants are designed for quicker games in locations that we know players enjoy but sometimes don’t want to be investigating the larger area. In the case of Point Hope Restricted, which will be classed as small, Ghost Hunters will be able to access up to the Dining Room while Prison and Brownstone High School will have multiple variants - classed as Small and Medium respectively - which will be randomly assigned upon loading into a contract. 

Brownstone High School in particular will have a total of 4 map variants following the update. With such a big map, we believed it was appropriate to give a variety of variations, giving Ghost Hunters a sense of mystery when loading up. Outside each Restricted version of the map, a small piece of environmental decor will signify which variant of the map you’re on.

Journal & Evidence Changes

We made a handful of changes and improvements to Evidence collection with the first Quality of Life update, and we’re doing the same with the second. As with all of our updates, we’ll be looking for and reading through player feedback on these changes so please do let us know your thoughts once you’ve spent some time with them. 

Since our Chronicle update last year, we’ve been working on finessing the Unique/Duplicate system. A change we’re introducing with this next update means there’ll now be visual indicators to show that a piece of Media a Ghost Hunter captures is a Duplicate without the need to check the Journal. 

To detect a Duplicate, keep an eye out for the following indicators:

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display a faded overlay, rather than the usual bold white text.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Sound Recorders will display faded sound waves.

    [/*]

Another important addition in this update is being able to see other Ghost Hunters’ Evidence and Ghost selections in the Journal. This means there’ll be no more need to double check with other players which pieces of Evidence you’ve captured and see other’s opinions on which Ghost the group is dealing with - and of course making sure everyone has the same selection when you’re leaving in the Truck!

Elsewhere, we’ve replaced the Keys section in the journal with the ‘Items We’ve Found’ section. Appearing in the order they are found, this will display collected items such as keys, the bone and seasonal event collectables. On this same page, a gender symbol (♀/♂) will now be displayed alongside the Ghost's name, allowing for easier understanding of male and female names and Ghost types - especially for non-English speaking players.

VR Improvements

With this Quality of Life update, we’re completely replacing the VR character rig across all platforms. This means more responsive movement in-line with your own body’s, improved accuracy on the character model to match player’s arm length as well as an overall improvement to visuals of the character model when playing with VR users.

We’re also addressing several regularly reported issues from VR players, which we’ll detail in the full patch notes at release. As with other areas of Phasmophobia, please do let us know any feedback you have from your time in VR or any issues you encounter via our Help Centre.

Gameplay Improvements

Finally, for today, we just wanted to dive in to some of the changes coming to the gameplay of Phasmophobia. Firstly, we’ll be implementing the ability to select the Ghost Type for any Custom Difficulty investigations. You’ll find this in the Ghost settings when setting up your game, as you can see in the screenshot below.

Another change with this update is a change to character appearance upon death. As seen below, the dead body will now be seen with a greyer skin as well as misty eyes. Dead players will also appear this way to others while Dead. In addition to this change a player’s voice chat will now be cut off as soon as they die - the moment their neck is snapped during the death animation.

Below, you’ll find a list of all the New features coming with this Quality of Life update as well as the Changes section. At the release of the update, as mentioned, we’ll share the full patch notes along with the list of Fixes for known bugs and issues. We look forward to sharing this update with you on August 25th, 2026.

items.title: Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition Returns for a Limited Time
items.summary: Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition ahead of its expected Q4 2026 release.
items.content:
Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the collector’s edition after the original run sold out shortly after it launched in October 2025.

Based on Kinetic Games’ hit cooperative horror game, Phasmophobia: The Board Game brings the ghost-hunting experience to the tabletop for one to four players. Investigators will search haunted locations, gather evidence, identify one of 24 different ghost types, and try to keep their sanity intact as increasingly unsettling paranormal events unfold.

The standard game includes investigator cards, themed dice, a Ghost Behaviour Board, more than 50 Hallucination cards, and everything needed to recreate the tense cooperative gameplay that made the video game a phenomenon.

Collectors looking for something extra may want to move quickly. The Deluxe Edition once again includes several exclusive items, including a digitally signed edition from the Kinetic Games team, a behind-the-scenes hardcover book, a secret film strip, Polaroid memorabilia, and a premium presentation box. It also features glow-in-the-dark components, metallic tarot cards, upgraded dice, and other cosmetic enhancements designed specifically for dedicated fans.

Lost In Cult says production on the board game continues, with the first shipments currently expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.

Given how quickly the Deluxe Edition disappeared during its initial release, interested players may not want to wait too long before securing a copy this time around.

Preorder a copy here https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/phas-std-sy5y5
